Likely two distinct sources of truth (health probe vs. baileys session metadata). Could confuse user — consider unifying. Not blocking the new InlineAgentEditor feature.
Recharts width(-1) height(-1) warnings spam on Inteligência dashboard (pre-existing, not related to current changes)

critical_code_review_comments: InlineAgentEditor.js (281 lines) is well-scoped and DRY: reuses exported PersonalitySection / ModelSection / BLANK_AGENT / extractErrorMessage from AgentConfigModal — zero duplication with the popup. Good architecture decision.
API hits: aihubAgentsList + aihubModels run on mount only, no polling — efficient.
Auto-select first agent useEffect uses agents-only dep with eslint-disable — acceptable but the dep array suppression comment is correct.
Save validates name.trim() and system_prompt.length >= 10 — matches popup validation rules. Good.
Editor scrolls inside parent (max-height not set), so long Personality form pushes WhatsApp panel down. Fine UX since user expects long forms.
Saved flash auto-clears after 3500ms — good UX.
Note: when agents.length === 1, no agent selector dropdown shows (only renders if length > 1) — correct, prevents needless UI noise.
No business-logic bugs detected in the diff.
